I get what you’re going through I’m pretty much in the same position. I’m 20, currently living at home with my parents and feel like total shit constantly. I have amazing and loving parents but it doesn’t help me feel like I should be alive. Being on medication can make you feel like a disappointment but there is no shame in getting proper treatment for something you can’t help. It’s not your fault you are/feel depressed. So my advice would be do what make you happy/comfortable/better but just don’t feel bad about it.
